fine_trace.code: ret = mbedtls_x509_crt_parse_der( chain, ssl->in_msg + i, n );
fine_trace.note: The attacker-controlled server Certificate handshake message is parsed during the TLS client handshake: each DER certificate in the chain, including the one carrying the malformed subjectAltName extension, is handed to the X.509 DER parser.

While iterating the v3 extensions, the parser matches extnID 2.5.29.17 (MBEDTLS_X509_EXT_SUBJECT_ALT_NAME) and dispatches the extnValue OCTET STRING (GeneralNames) to the subject alternative name parser.

The malformed [0] otherName entry makes mbedtls_x509_parse_subject_alt_name return an error (ASN1_OUT_OF_DATA, not FEATURE_UNAVAILABLE). The error path frees every allocated node of subject_alt_name->next but never clears subject_alt_name->next itself, leaving the head's next pointer dangling to freed heap memory.

The SAN parsing error propagates out of x509_get_crt_ext; the DER parse core treats it as a fatal parse failure and immediately calls mbedtls_x509_crt_free while crt->subject_alt_names.next is already a dangling pointer.

Certificate cleanup starts seq_cur at cert_cur->subject_alt_names.next, which still points to the freed sequence node; dereferencing seq_cur->next reads freed heap memory, followed by a zeroize write to freed memory and a double free (heap use-after-free).

vuln_logic.issue_alignment: A malformed subjectAltName extension is crafted as GeneralNames = SEQUENCE { [2] dNSName "example.com", [0] otherName with empty content, [2] dNSName "example.org" }. Parsing the third entry makes x509_get_subject_alt_name validate the preceding [0] otherName, whose empty payload makes x509_get_other_name fail with ASN1_OUT_OF_DATA. The error cleanup frees the allocated sequence node (subject_alt_name->next) without clearing subject_alt_name->next; the subsequent certificate cleanup in mbedtls_x509_crt_free traverses this dangling pointer and reads freed heap memory. The certificate is delivered to the mbedtls TLS client via a crafted ServerHello + Certificate handshake stream.
